text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
It's hard to believe summer camp is
already over.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Hehe, I think so. Thanks to your support.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure I'll overcome my past in the
Mainichi
Okan and autumn Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Just because summer camp is
over, doesn't
mean our work is.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And like that, my final summer camp
with Silence
Suzuka comes to an end.
